title: Poland mourns six people killed in Krakow shooting as prosecutors open terror probe
caption:
Poland has begun two days of national mourning after a gunman killed six people and wounded 15 in Krakow's Main Square on Saturday. Three more bodies, believed to be his parents and sister, were found at his family home. Prosecutors are investigating the attack as a terrorist offence, and officials say the 24-year-old suspect held far-right views.
